message.reasoning: Mark against rubric. C1: intro covers mission, rationale, single spacecraft, users — good, references present. Accomplished ~8. C2: mission design covers launch, orbit with elements, STK screenshots, ground station, comms frequency, duration, EOL. Some errors: "very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" (contradiction), drag sail logic muddled, RAAN value arbitrary, no hand calc for inclination (plot only). Adequate-to-accomplished; give 7. C3: conclusion summarizes but somewhat generic; 6. C4: structure good, figures labelled but some captions odd, bibliography bare URLs, Wikipedia used (not acceptable source), minor grammar issues. Adequate ~5-6; give 5.
